title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
gist: Google DeepMind launched Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a video generation model now generally available on the Gemini API and Google Cloud, with native 15-second clips (up from 10), better reference adherence, multi-turn conversational editing and a 30% price cut to $0.07 per second of 720p video. Customer testimonials from Adobe, Figma, Monks, Whering, Stan, Magnific and Resemble AI signal enterprise and creative-tool adoption.

insights.claim: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash cuts price 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 to $0.07 per second of 720p video.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Aggressive price cuts intensify competition in AI video generation and pressure rival model margins.
insights.quote: We have dropped the price 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 making it available at $0.07 per second for 720p video.

insights.claim: Google promotes a cost-saving workflow of drafting at 360p or 720p, fixing details with follow-up edits instead of regenerating, then upscaling the best outputs to 1080p or 4K.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Edit-not-regenerate workflows lower effective cost per finished asset, widening the addressable ad-production market.

insights.claim: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generates and edits video natively up to 15 seconds, up from 10 seconds in Omni 1.1, with duration selectable in one-second increments from 3 to 15 seconds, enough for full social ad spots.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: 15-second native clips match standard social ad formats, making the model directly usable for ad production.

insights.claim: The model conditions on character, product or style images, motion clips up to three seconds and audio cues, keeping faces, garments, packaging typography and brand colors consistent across camera angles.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Brand consistency is the key barrier for commercial use; improvement targets e-commerce and advertising budgets.

insights.claim: Multi-turn conversational editing works across full 15-second clips, letting users swap products, backgrounds, lighting or aspect ratio turn by turn to create ad variants without re-generating.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Enables cheap creative versioning at scale, a direct threat to traditional video production services.

insights.claim: Google acknowledges ongoing development is needed for fast sports action, rapid script changes and complex physics.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Known weaknesses bound near-term use cases to ads, explainers and product content.

insights.claim: For the first time Gemini Omni is generally available, backed by Google Cloud enterprise infrastructure with Provisioned Throughput, and outputs carry an imperceptible SynthID watermark.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: GA with provisioned capacity converts video generation into recurring Google Cloud revenue.

insights.claim: Google is distributing Omni 1.2 Flash across the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Google Cloud console, Flow, Google Vids at no additional cost for Workspace users, the Gemini app for Google AI Ultra subscribers, and Google Ads.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Bundling into Workspace and Ads leverages Google's distribution to drive adoption and ad spend.

insights.claim: Adobe integrates Gemini Omni Flash in Adobe Firefly and is adding 1.2, while Figma Weave lets teams direct full video sequences from a single generation.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Partnerships with incumbent creative-software platforms position Google as a model supplier rather than competitor to Adobe and Figma.

insights.claim: Agency Monks calls Gemini Omni its go-to engine for reliable VFX and controllable video, and Whering reports superior garment drape and color matching with lower latency for virtual try-on.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Early agency and fashion-commerce adoption indicates traction in advertising and e-commerce verticals.
insights.quote: Gemini Omni has become our go-to engine for reliable VFX and controllable video generation.
insights.locator: Monks has been an early tester

insights.claim: Indian gaming and creator platform Stan used Gemini Omni to turn still images into vertical 15-second festival promos and commerce ads in a single prompt with native audio.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Shows adoption in emerging-market creator commerce.

insights.claim: Deepfake-detection firm Resemble AI praised the model's consistency and natural multilingual speech while welcoming Google's built-in provenance.
insights.speaker: Anish Nangia
insights.so_what: Improving realism raises the importance of provenance and detection, a growing market niche.
